<!--
Thanks for contributing! Please fill this in and make sure the checklist holds.
-->

## What & why

Describe the change and the reason for it. Link any related issue
(`Closes #…`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Docs / chore / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` is clean
- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test` passes
- [ ] `flutter test` passes (added/updated tests for the change)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] Screenshots/screen recording attached for UI changes
- [ ] No secrets, keystores or generated junk committed

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that helps the review — screenshots, device tested on, known
limitations, follow-ups.
